data_fields.name: normalise_race_speed
data_fields.donor_constant: false (settings-default.cfg:331); when false, horizontal speed multiplied by race weight

data_fields.name: collision_scale_by_race
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: collision uses cell scale only (rendering=false returns early)

data_fields.name: list_index_wrap
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: forward step past end returns 0 (wrap)

data_fields.name: class_quiz_majority
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 questions; one bucket above 7 gives one class (aside)

best_idea: A body family is a race-and-gender record holding two ratios (weight and height); scale is render-only and collision stays at the cell scale, so every body fights on identical hit geometry.
decision_why: Keep the shape (race x gender ratios, head and hair lists filtered by race and sex, render-only scale) and drop race weight from movement speed, because a duel's speed is server-verified and must not vary by body unless a ruling says so.
acceptance: A heavy and a light body of the same race stand on the same rig with the same hit extents, and a server test asserts two bodies with different ratios give identical hit extents and identical movement speed.
